'''Moaneill''', or is an overseas region of [[Etirha]] located on the eastern coast of [[New Ayre]] in the [[Demeeri]]. Bordered by [[Maalle]] and [[Nia]] to the west, [[Aplasia]] to the north, [[Veelmit]] to the south, and the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the east and south, Moaneill covers a total area of {{convert|298,000|km2|abbr=on}}
[[File:Paramaribo WPM 20220915 221 106 L4 BAND4321.png|thumb| View of Talvasha from above, June 1758]]

Moaneill is the ___-largest [[Regions of Etirha|region of Etirha]], being approximately one-fifth the size of [[Etirha|Mainland Etirha]]. It has a very low population density, with only {{convert|7.2|PD/sqkm|abbr=out}}. About a third of its residents live in its capital, [[Talvasha]]. Approximately 96.9% of Moaneill is covered by forests,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fakioo.org/faostat/las/#data/EL |title=Fakioo – Land Use |publisher=[[Food and Agriculture Organization]]}}</ref> much of it [[wikipedia:Old-growth forest|primeval]] [[wikipedia:Tropical rainforest|rainforest]]. [[Moaneill Demeerian Park]], one of the largest [[wikipedia:national park|national park]] in the world, covers 81% of Moaneill's territory.

Since December 1746, both the region and department have been ruled by a single assembly within the framework of a single territorial collectivity, the Moaneill Territorial Collectivity. This assembly, the [[Moaneill Assembly]], replaced the former [[Regional Council of Moaneill|regional council]], which was dissolved. The Moaneill Assembly is in charge of regional and departmental government. 
[[File:Panorama depuis l'île Royale.jpg|thumb|View from the [[Reoda Islands]], [[Eulasti]]]]

Fully integrated in the United Provinces of Etirha since 1696. A large part of Moaneill's economy depends on jobs and businesses associated with the presence of the [[Moaneill Space Centre]], a jointly owned Raledrian-Etirhan launch site near the equator. As elsewhere in Etirha, the official language is standard Ersuckl, but each ethnic community has its own language, of which [[Lastnu language]], a constructed language, is the most widely spoken. Moaneill is the only territory on the continental mainland of the [[New Ayre]] that is still under the sovereignty of a non-[[New Ayre|Ayren]] state.
